programme.title: Любовь с ароматом кофе
programme.desc: Красавица Аля – мать-одиночка, работает баристой и воспитывает 5-ти летнего сына. Бывший парень бросил ее одну с ребенком. Девушка долго никого не подпускала к себе, пока не встретила мажора Гошу. И впервые за долгое время подумала, что он ― тот мужчина, с которым можно шагать по жизни легко и просто. Но Гоша бросает девушку. В это время Аля встречает друга Гоши Костю, который предлагает ей сделку: сыграть роль его несносной, бесцеремонной невесты, чтобы семья перестала думать о женитьбе Кости. Но все идет не по плану….

Но Гоша бросает девушку. В это время Аля встречает друга Гоши Костю, который предлагает ей сделку: сыграть роль его несносной, бесцеремонной невесты, чтобы семья перестала думать о женитьбе Кости. Но все идет не по плану….

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Engineering an Empire
programme.desc: In an era long passed, mighty empires were forged from nothing and rose to the heights of power. Join host Peter Weller, an actor and a professor at Syracuse University as he travels the world to show the engineering feats that gave rise to some of the greatest civilizations known to man. From Rome to the Pharaohs' Egypt, from Greece to Carthage, from the Aztecs to the Maya and more, this new program from the History Channel uses computer graphics to explore the architectural, political and cultural glory of the world's greatest empires.

programme.title: Mankind Decoded
programme.desc: Using dramatic reconstructions, this fascinating documentary series explores the evolution and advancement of the human race, dissecting the key events and changes that have affected and altered various civilisations. Each episode in this 12-part series focusses on a unique transformation of our ancestors, as they discovered more and more about the planet they inhabit. With expert historians offering explanations to these changes, the series reveals how powerful forces of nature compelled humans to adapt, the birth of war, the discovery of fire and metals, and the building of giant structures, among many others.

programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

programme.title: Where Did It Come From?
programme.desc: Documentary series exploring the history of Earth's greatest man-made structures and creations. Where Did It Come From? reveals the earliest examples of brilliance and ingenuity from past pioneers. From the Roman highway project; a civil engineering feat establishing a network of unprecedented highways, to Egypt's iconic structures, this series reveals the incomprehensible ides brought to life by magnificent minds, and in some cases, brutal slavery. Join host Michael Guillen as he dives into this fascinating world of both civil and social engineering, born out of ideas we still use today.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Engineering an Empire
programme.desc: In an era long passed, mighty empires were forged from nothing and rose to the heights of power. Join host Peter Weller, an actor and a professor at Syracuse University as he travels the world to show the engineering feats that gave rise to some of the greatest civilizations known to man. From Rome to the Pharaohs' Egypt, from Greece to Carthage, from the Aztecs to the Maya and more, this new program from the History Channel uses computer graphics to explore the architectural, political and cultural glory of the world's greatest empires.

programme.title: Mankind Decoded
programme.desc: Using dramatic reconstructions, this fascinating documentary series explores the evolution and advancement of the human race, dissecting the key events and changes that have affected and altered various civilisations. Each episode in this 12-part series focusses on a unique transformation of our ancestors, as they discovered more and more about the planet they inhabit. With expert historians offering explanations to these changes, the series reveals how powerful forces of nature compelled humans to adapt, the birth of war, the discovery of fire and metals, and the building of giant structures, among many others.

programme.title: The Tesla Files
programme.desc: Why were trunks belonging to genius inventor Nikola Tesla confiscated in 1943? Did they contain the plans for nearly free worldwide electricity, massive death rays, and other inventions out of the future? A new investigation driven by declassified CIA documents suggests a secret history of bitter rivalries, government conspiracies, Cold War and WW2 spycraft, extra-terrestrial communication, and amazing achievements of a truly gifted man – Nikola Tesla.

programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: oberts and Laidlaw have uncovered a fatal flaw in the Royal Navy's existing anti-U-Boat tactic 'Buttercup'. By wargaming different scenarios, they develop a countertactic of their own, codenamed 'Raspberry', in which a merchant convoy escorted by Royal Navy destroyers can lure in the wolfpack before surrounding and destroying it; in effect, playing the enemy at its own game. But the team now faces an uphill battle to try to convince Noble and his colleagues at the Admiralty that they hold the key to stopping the U-Boats in the Atlantic.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Japan, 1612: Legendary samurai Musashi meets arch rival Kojiro in a climactic duel. Modern-day warrior SFC Terry Schappert goes inside some of the most famous warrior cultures of all time to explore their weaponry, tactics and psyche.

programme.title: Утро
programme.desc: Утренняя новостная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Ждём в гости
programme.desc: Проект Ирины Хангошвили о культуре, истории и традициях различных стран мира. Ведущий - Зураб Двали - путешествует и приглашает зрителей пройтись вместе с ним по красивым местам, увидеть достопримечательности, полюбоваться природой и познакомиться с интересными людьми. Всюду гостеприимные хозяева говорят нашим телезрителям: "Ждем в гости!" Зрители сначала узнают интересные исторические факты о самых известных или забытых регионах различных стран, и затем останавливаются на кулинарных традициях - готовят несколько блюд с гостями программы.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: Моя звезда
programme.desc: Костя и Маша дружили со студенческих лет. И Костя был единственным, кто не замечал, что все эти годы Маша влюблена в него… Мечта девушки о взаимности гасла день за днем. И, наконец, она решила ничего больше не ждать и ответила на чувства своего давнего поклонника Кирилла. Счастливый Кирилл сделал ей предложение, вот только свадьба так и не состоялась - жених умер от сердечного приступа. И теперь Маше надо понять, что делать с тремя его детьми от первого брака. На Костю тоже сваливается беда: его названая мать тяжело больна и просит его позаботиться о своей воспитаннице Кристине. Костя забирает девушку с собой в Москву, еще не представляя, во что ввязался. У Кристины две мечты - стать звездой кинематографа и выйти замуж за олигарха. В итоге все выйдет совсем не так, как представлялось героям. Хотя, возможно, гораздо лучше.

programme.title: Мелодия на два голоса
programme.desc: Ирина и Сергей знакомятся друг с другом не в лучший для них обоих день: их встреча происходит в загсе, где они оба оформляют развод со своими вторыми половинами... Ирина - дочь успешного и известного в городе бизнесмена Романа Алексеевича Кудряшова. Привыкшая к роскоши и достатку, она остаётся доброй и скромной девушкой. После окончания института Ирина выбирает для себя нелегкую работу врача-акушера в роддоме. Сергей - парень из обычной интеллигентной семьи. Своей головой и своим трудом он добился хорошего образования и интересной работы. Любовь, захлестнувшая Ирину и Сергея, даёт им обоим надежду на счастье. Они решают быть вместе, и им не терпится познакомить друг с другом своих родителей. Но неожиданно для молодых это знакомство оборачивается катастрофой...

programme.title: Госпожа Фазилет и ее дочери
programme.desc: Госпожа Фазилет после того, как потеряла мужа, одна воспитывает двух дочек. Вся жизнь Фазилет прошла в сожалениях, поэтому теперь ее вкладом в будущее стала младшая дочь Эдже. Но самым большим препятствием на пути матери является старшая дочь Хазан, которая несмотря на свою изысканную красоту ведет себя по-мальчишески и не ладит с матерью. Семья Эймен богата, могущественна, у них особняк на берегу Босфора, и однажды их пути пересекаются с Фазилет и ее дочерьми. Богатство Эймен даже превосходит мечты Фазилет. После знакомства с ними изменится не только жизнь Эдже, но и Хазан, которая влюбится в Синана Эймена, избалованного сына семьи.

programme.title: Провинциальный детектив
programme.desc: Заведующая городской библиотекой Татьяна Дашкова и медсестра Ольга Брянцева живут в небольшом очаровательном городке с древней историей и дружат с детства. Образованность, начитанность и неиссякаемый интерес к жизни Татьяны, в сочетании с практичностью, находчивостью и живостью ума Ольги дают удивительные результаты. Их тандем способен разобраться в самых запутанных ситуациях и выяснить истинные мотивы любого преступления, которых случается немало в этом, кажущемся спокойным, городке. Главное — внимание к мелочам и деталям, а также хорошее знание детективной литературы. Ведь героиням во всех делах помогают Шерлок Холмс, Отец Браун и другие известные детективы из произведений классической литературы.

programme.title: Главное
programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Пять минут тишины. Возвращение
programme.desc: На базу приезжает журналистка с оператором, чтобы снять репортаж о спасателях. Гости не афишируют, что их главная цель — сделать горячий сюжет о грабителе-фантоме. Как назло, вызовы в день их приезда сплошь пустяковые, и журналисты, расстроенные нехваткой сенсационного материала, отправляются отдыхать. В это время на открытии выставки \"Сокровища севера\" происходит задымление, посетителей эвакуируют. В нужный момент на выставке появляется загадочный \"фантом\"…

programme.title: Ольга
programme.desc: Главная героиня воспитывает двух детей от разных браков, заботится об отце-алкоголике и пытается наладить личную жизнь. Старшая дочь Анька учится в ПТУ, думает, что она единственный адекватный член семьи и в её жизни все будет по-другому, младший сын Тимофей, чей отец вернулся к первой семье в Азербайджан, считает, что он уже мужчина, хотя ему всего лишь 11 лет, отец Ольги, бывший футболист, крепко выпивает и постоянно врет, а сестра Ленка пытается жить за счет мужчин, в основном — женатых. Вечно спасая родственников от неприятностей, Ольга живет чужой жизнью и редко думает о себе — до тех пор, пока в нее не влюбляется молодой и положительный водитель газели "Ритуал" Гриша.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Голое влечение. Германия
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Первые ласточки
programme.desc: Катя вынуждена нарушить молчание и рассказать про послания Полины следователю. Дэн тоже решает раскрыть тайну: об ориентации Феди узнаёт весь класс. После аварии Лера впадает в кому и становится главным подозреваемым. На неё указывают все улики, в том числе содержимое её компьютера. Но Ольгу Макарову мучают сомнения.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.title: Anderson Cooper 360
programme.desc: Anderson Cooper delves into the day's news, looking beyond the broadcast to give his take, prompting us to re-think what we hear in the headlines. Cooper has covered major, international stories like the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina on the Gulf Coast, the catastrophic BP oil spill and the 2010 earthquake in Haiti, which saw the whole world fall silent. The show has won an absolute plethora of awards over the years, including GLAAD Media and Emmy awards.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Craig and his two best friends, Kelsey and JP, are always going on adventures in the untamed suburban wilderness known as the Creek - a kid utopia where tribes of children rule over tree forts and bike ramps, making up an entire kid society. Each episode finds the kids either venturing into unexplored areas of the Creek, encountering new Creek Kids, or just getting into trouble at their hang out - the Stump.

programme.title: Lana Longbeard
programme.desc: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father's adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

programme.title: Craig of the Creek

With winter over and spring beginning, Kelsey befriends a girl named Sun Chun who owns a hamster named Cookie and runs a giant hamster tunnel all over the Creek - when Craig and JP discover that Cookie has been killed by a cat, Sun Chun becomes inconsolable. Taking Kelsey's words literally, Sun then steals 100 hamsters in an effort to ease her misery...

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin brings Starfire on a fake stakeout in an attempt to get a kiss while Cyborg and Beast Boy hold their own stakeout to discover Raven's dark secret. / When The Brain captures the Titans to fuel Project B.R.I.A.N. the Titan's little buddies are the only heroes who can save them. / In order to get his powers back Beast Boy returns to nature and finds it much harsher than he expects. / Raven is delighted when the other Titans are magically turned into old people during a battle.

programme.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
programme.desc: Benson gets booted out of Heir to the Throne.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai and Rigby beat Muscle Man and High-Five Ghost in a cart race and pick up some girls who have some flat tires. However they soon destroy the cart so Benson punishes them by taking away their cart privileges and forcing them to ride kiddie bikes. Angered at the "uncoolness of the bikes Mordecai protests the decision due to them taking away their cool appeal. He strikes a deal with Benson: if Benson admits that they're cool then they can get their cart privileges back. Mordecai and Rigby do whatever they can wearing cool sunglasses dressing up in stylish clothes but Benson refuses to admit that they are cool. Trouble ensues when the cool police arrest Mordecai and Rigby for being too cool and they are taken to a distant planet for trial. Benson is then called over as a witness where he finally admits that Mordecai and Rigby are cool. The judge determines their sentence - death. Mordecai Rigby and Benson all escape alive after setting the planet to detonate.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: At the snack bar Alpha Dog Demel-ishun Blitz Comet and the Crew have been challenging people to rap battles with all of them losing including one nicknamed Big Trouble. Pops shows up and tries to beat them with poetry but he gets humiliated. Angered Pops challenges them to a rap duel. Mordecai and Rigby try to help Pops with the rapping because he cannot rap only recite poetry. However Pops refuses to rap negativity against the CrewCrew so he decides to stick with poetry. Soon Mordecai and Rigby realise the beauty of poetry but they decide not to go after poetry and call Pops a loser. Skips tells Mordecai to help Pops and they go there to try and settle the score. At first the rappers seem to enjoy their depressing mood to the scene but Pops' poem about happiness brings them to tears.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Clarence
programme.desc: Follow the daily adventures of a 10-year-old boy named Clarence, and his two best friends Sumo and Jeff. Clarence lives with his mother Mary and her boyfriend Chad in the fictional town of Aberdale, and he is optimistic, curious, honest and quirky boy, who sees the best in everyone and gets himself in a variety of funny situations and everyday problems, which he solves with lots of imagination and with the help from his friends.

programme.title: Lana Longbeard
programme.desc: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father's adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai and Rigby are slacking off again, this time with a stick hockey table. Benson finds out and makes a deal with the two if they finish all their work, they can play stick hockey. However, Benson goes against his word and sells the stick hockey table to a thrift store, who sells it to a pawn shop. Mordecai and Rigby set out to retrieve the stick hockey table, and end up in a stick hockey tournament. Benson feels guilty about lying, so he goes over to the tournament, where he finds a beat-up Mordecai and Rigby. Benson comes out to face an old rival named Chong who had killed his friend (another gumball machine). It's up to Benson to avenge his friend and save Mordecai and Rigby from Chong.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Xplore Oman
programme.desc: Documentary series. A world of rich and vibrant culture awaits in this stunning travel series exploring the historic country of Oman. Known officially as the Sultanate of Oman and positioned on the southeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula, the show explores the staggering history behind this beautiful kingdom. With a population of just over 4 million, this uniquely untouched country is still finding its feet in the Western tourism industry. From its four UNESCO World Heritage sites, which in itself reveals the extraordinary history and architecture that exists in Oman, to its famed horse-breeding, Oman is a country that will undoubtedly surprise you.

programme.desc: "Kälimeeste" neljandal hooajal tuleb mängu uusi tegelasi ning vanade ümber puhuvad uued tuuled. Rebekkal (Merle Palmiste) on uus mees. Priidikul (Henrik Normann) on uus amet. Urmasel (Sepo Seeman) on uus kodu. Viksil (Andrus Vaarik) on uus äri. Poliitikul (Veikko Täär) on uus kabinet. Riinal (Hilje Murel) on uued mured. Ämmal (Ene Järvis) on uued sepitsused. Udumuna Jürkal (Ago Anderson) on uued himud. Seltskonda lisanduvad Rebekka uus sõbranna Maarika (Marilyn Jurman) ning Urmase uus kolleeg Arts (Johannes Veski).

programme.title: Kättemaksukontor
programme.desc: Lumi-Lee avastab, et lugu Kalju röövist tulnukate poolt on netti jõudnud ja pettuseks osutunud. Kalju satub naeruväärsesse olukorda. Ometi suudab Freya kogu hämust läbi näha ja leida seose lähedal uppunud tüdruku ja tulnukate röövi vahel ning lõpuks ka tõelise mõrvari paljastada.

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: Laura kohtub staariga, kes on nõus tema saates esinema ja on valmis ka nende agentuuris pulmad korraldama, staari pulmaplaan on aga suur saladus. Kristina otsustab samas, et neil on reklaami vaja ja kuulutab staari pulmad suurelt välja. See ajab Laura kõigi Eesti seltskonnainimestega tülli ja ta ei leia enam oma saatesse ühtegi kuulsat külalist. Samal ajal leitakse aga ootamatu lahendus stiilipeo-pulma jaoks, kui selgub, et Laura sugulane Ken-Robin on Ott Tänaku täpne koopia.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Rein Paabel ja Relika Solnoskova üritavad oma patrullitööle keskenduda, ehkki on 1. aprill ja kõik ettevõtmised kipuvad veidraid pöördeid võtma. Päeva lõpuks on jaoskonnas toimuvad intriigid ja väljakutsetel juhtuvad jaburused Reinu ja Relika omavahelise suhte totaalselt puntrasse ajanud. Reinu naine saab kummalise tööpakkumise ja lisaks kõigele tabab piirkonda uus šokk - kaob järjekordne riigikogu liige.

programme.title: Nautilus
programme.desc: Kapten Nemo ja tema meeskond on sunnitud tegema peatuse Karajani saarel vee ja varude saamiseks. Nemo avastab šokeeriva tõe. Humility saab teada, kes Nemo tegelikult on.

programme.title: Kodu korda
programme.desc: Taylorid osalevad iga-aastasel riistvaranäitusel.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Käsikiri: 2003–2010 Kerttu Rakke, 2010– Mihkel Ulman 2010– Livia Ulman 2010– Andris Feldmanis Peaosades Martin Veinmann, Kleer Maibaum, Indrek Ojari jt Kodumaise sarja keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond: pereisa Hannes, tema naine Helen ning nende väike poeg. Elu hakkab probleemseks minema siis, kui nende ukse taha saabub Liis - Hannese tütar tema eelmisest abielust. Intriige punuvad ka naabrid, tuttavad ja sugulased.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Madeline pannakse proovile, kui juhtum avab vanad haavad. Heasüdamlik pakkumine toob endaga kaasa saladuse paljastamise. Kontorisse häkitakse sisse.

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: Laura mees Christian teeb tüdrukutele korraliku kollektiivikoolituse, mis lõpeb korraliku tüliga, kui Kristina kahtlustab, et sõbrannad üritavad talle koolituse varjus hoopis ajupesu teha. Maria on hädas kirjastaja skandaalimaigulise turundusstrateegiaga, mis on ta sugulased üles ärritanud. Kristina kardab, et tüdrukud tahavad teda juhatajatroonilt tõugata, samas kui Laura on absoluutselt kindel, et olekski ise pulmaagentuurile parem juhataja kui Kristina ja kriis süveneb veelgi.

programme.title: Kullakesed
programme.desc: Dorothy, Blanche, Rose ja Sophia on neli eakat vanadaami. Nende kõigi suurimaks ühiseks jooneks on nende abikaasad - kõik on kas surnud või lahutand. Neli vanamemme otsustavad kokku kolida, et vanaduspõlve hõlpsamaks ning huvitavamaks teha.Kuid samas pole mitte ühelgi neist kadunud ammune janu meeste järgi. Igaüks üritab endale pidevalt kaaslast leida ning vahest ka teiselt üle trumbata.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Relika Solnoskova ja salakaval Urmas Viil naudivad Egiptuses puhkust, samal ajal kui Rein Paabel peab patrullima äkilise konstaabel Silega. Rein saab vaatamata sekeldustele riigikogulaste kadumise kohta kummalise vihje. Eesti politseijõud on riigikogulaste kadumise pärast kriisis ja jaoskonda külastab kõrge külaline siseministeeriumist. Rein leiab aga ootamatult idee,kuidas lohutada oma naist, kes on saamata jäänud lõunamaareisi pärast väga okkaline. Vahepeal selgub aga, et kadunud on veel mitmed riigikogulased ja politseijaoskonnast peab lahkuma esimene töötaja.

programme.title: Kättemaksukontor
programme.desc: Kaur Moks sõidab Indiasse elu mõtet otsima. Buddha püha bodhi-puu all ta selle leiabki. Kui ta mõni aeg hiljem Eestisse naaseb, on mees tundmatusi muutunud ja loonud endale sekti, mis koosneb eranditult noortest ja kaunitest neidudest. Kuid õige juhtub midagi, mis sunnib Armastusekahurit Kättemaksukontorilt abi otsima.

programme.title: Beverly Hills, 90210
programme.desc: Brenda ja Donna osalevad loomaõiguste meeleavaldusel. Brenda arreteeritakse. Dylan keeldub Lucinda filmi rahastamast. Dylan lööb Steve'i.

programme.title: Skandaal
programme.desc: Endine USA Presidendi meediasuhete konsultant Olivia Pope on nüüd kriisijuht, kes suudab lahendada kõik probleemid nii, et keegi ei teagi, et sellised probleemid olemas olid. Kuid ükskõik kui hoolas sa oled oma töös, võid samal ajal enda eraelus väga palju kahju teha. Igal nädalal seisavad Olivia ja ta meeskond silmitsi paljude probleemidega, mis vajavad lahendamist. Ning kui nad suudavad päästa teiste inimeste elusid, ei tähenda see seda, et nad suudavad parandada ka enda omi.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Olympia ja Julian uurivad lapse surmaga seotud juhtumit. Madeline'i kaalub kõrge stressitaseme tõttu tagasiastumist. Olympia ja Julian mõtlevad oma lahutusele.

programme.title: Rannavalve
programme.desc: Ühes Los Angelese rannas tegutseb vetelpäästjate rühm, mida juhib Mitch Buchannon. Nad päästavad elusid, maadlevad eraeluliste muredega, võitlevad kuritegevuse vastu ja löövad kaasa uskumatutes seiklustes.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Telelavastuse tegevus toimub ühe vaikse Eesti linnakese vaiksel kõrvaltänaval. Vaikelu saab aga rikutud, kui Urmase ja Riina kõrvalmajja kolib Riina õde Rebekka koos oma uue mehe Raivoga. Saatuse tahtel naabriteks ja kälimeesteks saanud Urmas ja Raivo on inimestena erinevad ning nende õdedest elukaaslased omavahel nagistanud lapsest saadik. Lavastuses näeme, kuidas üleaedsed peavad lahendama igale eestlasele nii tuttavaid probleeme naabrite läbikäimises ning mismoodi aitavad sellele kaasa õdede ellu sekkuv ema ning Raivo hämaravõitu äripartner Viks. Mängivad Peeter Oja, Sepo Seeman, Merle Palmiste, Hilje Murel, Ene Järvis, Andrus Vaarik, Jan Uuspõld, Ivo Eensalu jpt. Režissöör Rando Pettai, stsenarist Peep Pedmanson.

programme.desc: Sarja peategelasteks on kaks abielupaari, kelle suhted muudab keeruliseks ühe paari naise ja teise paari mehe vahel puhkenud kirg. 1998. aastal TV3 eetris jooksma hakanud seriaali stsenaariumi autorid olid Aita Kivi, Juhan Habicht ja Stella K. Wadowsky, toimetaja Tiina Lokk, näitejuht Rein Oja, režissöörid Toomas Kirss ja Kalev Lepik. Peaosadesmängisid Merle Palmiste, Marika Vernik, Ita Ever, Märt Visnapuu ja Ivo Uukkivi. Produtsent oli Toomas Kirss.

programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.desc: Kui kaitsepolitsei võtab vahele metamfetamiini laborit juhtiva jõuguliikme Marshall Carteri, avastavad nad ümberasustamise skeemi, kus välismaalt adopteeritud lapsed hüljatakse ja müüakse seejärel internetis maha.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: David Hodges jääb teadmata kadunuks ning kogu laborimeeskond peab andma endast kõik, et ta üles leida ning päästa tema ja labori hea nimi.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: Varjud paradiisis
programme.desc: Alisoni surnukeha avastatakse ning Gogo ja Edwin on tema mõrvas peamised kahtlustatavad. Emily valetab Joshile ja Sunitale ning jätkab Clive'i jälitamist.

programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: Danny kohtub unistuste naisega ning peagi satuvad nad eluohtlikusse avariise kohas, mis on igasugusest abist kaugel. McGarrett soovib, et Quinn ja Tani tuleks appi, kui koer Eddiel ilmnevad traumajärgse stressihäire märgid.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas

programme.title: Teistega voodis
programme.desc: USA 2015 romantiline komöödia Lavastaja:Leslye Headland Osades: Jason Sudeikis, Alison Brie, Jordan Carlos Suhtekomöödia keskmes on kaks kolledžiaegset üheöökallimat Lainey (Alison Brie) ja Jake (Jason Sudeikis). Kui seksihoolikutest paar pärast 12 aastast pausi New Yorgis uuesti kohtub, mõistavad mõlemad, et nende kirg teineteise vastu pole aastatest hoolimata jahtunud. Kuid vaatamata tungile teineteisega magada lepivad nad kokku, et hoiavad omavahelise suhte puhtalt platoonilise, samas kui teistega seksimine on lubatud.

programme.title: Tagasi Maa peal
programme.desc: Mustanahaline koomik sureb enne õiget aega ning saab valge ärimehe kehas uue võimaluse.

programme.title: Hormoonid, stringid ja kõvad banaanid
programme.desc: Tüdruk peab päevikut teismeea murede ja rõõmude kohta ning ühtlasi kirjutab üles kõik, mida ta suudlemise kohta teada saab.

programme.title: Õelad tüdrukud
programme.desc: USA 2004 Komöödia Lavastaja: Mark S. Waters Osades: Lindsay Lohan, Rachel McAdams, Lacey Chabert, Amanda Seyfried Cady Heron (Lindsay Lohan) on 15-aastane tüdruk, kes on terve elu koos zooloogidest vanematega Aafrika põõsaste all veetnud. Nüüd peab ta astuma aga tavalisse kooli ning kogeb omal nahal, et dzhungliseadused seal ei kehti. Tema teadmised ja arvamused olelusvõitlusest saavad hoopis uue tähenduse. Pikkus: 1 tund 37 minutit

programme.title: Farmi peoloomad
programme.desc: Kui farmer on ära, siis kõik loomad mängivad, laulavad ja tantsivad. Lõpuks peab aga keegi sekkuma ja juhtimise üle võtma ning vastutus jääb muretu lehma Otise kanda.

programme.title: Ei armastusele
programme.desc: 1962. aasta New Yorgis puhkeb pleiboist ajakirjaniku ja feministliku eneseabiautori vahel õide armastus.

programme.title: Wayne'i maailm
programme.desc: Film põhineb saate Saturday Night Live samanimelisel sketšil. Napakas ja kõiki piire kompavas popkultuuri-komöödias järgitakse armsalt sihitute heavy-meeste Wayne'i ja Garthi seiklusi.

programme.title: Kujuta ette
programme.desc: Edukat finantsanalüütikut ärritab tütre käitumine, kes klammerdub oma lemmikpleedi ja kujutletavate sõbrannade külge. Kuid nende nõuanded tõotavad tulu tuua.

programme.title: Saage tuttavaks - Dave
programme.desc: USA 2008 komöödia Lavastaja: Brian Robbins Osades: Eddie Murphy, Elizabeth Banks, Marc Blucas, Gabrielle Union, Ed Helms, Scott Caan Värskelt New Yorki saabunud Dave Ming Chang (Eddie Murphy) on otsekui kala kuival. Miski tema juures on viltu, mees näeb kõike ümbritsevat otsekui esimest korda ega tunne end oma kehas kuigi mugavalt. Põhjusega, sest tegelikult ei olegi "Dave" üldse inimene, vaid hoopis teiselt planeedilt saabunud… kosmoselaev, mis on loodud oma kapteni (Eddie Murphy) näo järgi. Avastusretk tundmatusse maailma alaku!

programme.title: Armuguru
programme.desc: Gurude poolt üles kasvatatud ameeriklane naaseb USAsse, et astuda eneseabi ärisse. Tema esimene väljakutse on teha korda staarhokimängija armuelu.

programme.title: Õhus
programme.desc: USA 2009 romantiline komöödia Lavastaja: Jason Reitman Osades: George Clooney, Vera Farmiga, Anna Kendrick, Jason Bateman Ryan Bingham (George Clooney) veedab enamuse oma ajast mööda Ühendriike ringi lennates ja inimesi vallandades - see on mehe elukutse, milles on ta lausa põrgulikult hea. Tema ideaalne karjäär aga ähvardab kokku variseda, kui firma palkab tööle noore naise Alexi (Vera Farmiga), kes tuleb lagedale uue innovaatilise lahendusega: hakata inimesi vallandama läbi Interneti. Päästmaks enda karjääri, otsustab Ryan teha kõik võimaliku, et Alexi idee ei teostuks.

programme.title: Jackass 3
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville ja kompanii on tagasi kolmandas järjeshow's, kus valitsevad ohtlikud kaskadööritrikid ja avameelsed paljastused.

programme.title: Lihtsalt liiga kuum
programme.desc: Romantilise komöödia keskmes on Pittsburghi lennujaamas turvamehena töötav äpu Kirk (Baruchel), kelle ainsaks elueesmärgiks on taaselustada suhe kunagise tüdruksõbra Marniega (Sloane). Juhuse tahtel kohtub ta nutika, seksika ja võluva Mollyga (Eve), kes on välimuselt 10 (samas kui Kirk ise on umbes 5) ning alustab temaga suhet. Kauaks see aga püsima jääb?
